name: Northstar Region
description: Northstar is a fictional Canadian region. All people, facilities, and events are simulated.

demographics.source: Statistics Canada 2024 vital statistics (crude birth 8.9 and crude death 8.0 per 1,000 per year, TFR 1.25) with 2021 census age structure. Fictional NorthStar values; all people are simulated.

coordinate_system.description: Authored local schematic coordinates; not WGS84 or real-world latitude/longitude. Legacy API lat/lon fields equal local y/x divided by 100.

context.inspiration: New Brunswick-inspired healthcare, bilingual English/French population, seasons and operating assumptions. These are modelling references, not claims about real communities.

spatial_reference.name: Northstar fictional engineering grid
spatial_reference.description: Planar metre coordinates in a fictional engineering grid. No Earth location or EPSG transformation is defined.

precision_types.simulated_point: Authored individual point, not surveyed or observed GPS
precision_types.district_centroid: District representative point; precise location unavailable

notes: District boundaries are an authored nearest-centre partition, not municipal boundaries.
Road links and speeds are authored for comparative spatial experiments. They do not model real streets, traffic or emergency driving.
Road junctions are explicit graph nodes. Network routing estimates do not alter existing simulation transition times.
Location precision distinguishes individual simulated points from district-centre fallbacks.
